what: geometry G-B as BUILT — the CLU store cell in 3 of 12 layers

ttt_criterion.criterion: eta*||theta_K z||^2 < 2 for a non-expansive inner loop; E||theta_K z||^2 = n||z||^2/d
ttt_criterion.consequence: ttt_normalized_write=True on the TTT arm — ALREADY RULED, PILOT-TTT-RULINGS.md ruling 1. ⛔ Not a new decision.
